name: Vellus
source:
"Me? I'm just your average angel, doing my part. I do love stories though... Don't tell anyone, but I'd love to write my own someday."

Vellus is young for an angel, and has worked hard to prove herself and earn a high position amongst her kind. Still, an emptiness haunts her as she attempts to conform to the heavy expectations laid out for her.

Sweet, naive Vellus, perpetually trapped in one way or another.

[From [url=https://flutteringabyss.itch.io/yonderworld]Itch.io[/url]]
